title: IdeaSeek ResultToClaim (result-to-claim-v1)
description: Structural contract for the deterministic result-to-claim derivation, mirroring the writer: `ideaseek idea result-to-claim` computes and persists this artifact to ideas/<ideaId>/experiments/result-to-claim.json (src/idea/result-to-claim.ts runResultToClaim + writeResultToClaim) with no model in the loop, so the schema accepts exactly what that literal emits. Checked structurally: the tag, ideaId, the nullable planInputHash, one entry per protocol primary metric with its support/direction words, the three delta values as number|null, and each evidence row's specId/specHash/role. What stays in TypeScript: the direction-adjusted delta arithmetic and the support rule (delta>0 -> supported, <=0 -> not-supported, missing evidence -> insufficient), the report<->registry integrity cross-check that turns a ghost spec into a gap, the verbatim (never re-parsed) protocol supportCriteria, and claimId slugification. ideaValue/baselineValue/delta are null whenever one side of the comparison is missing — that is an honest `insufficient` claim, not a malformed one, and `claims`/`gaps` may both be short (no report at all yields empty claims with a recovery gap).
